name: ActiveCampaign
description: ActiveCampaign is a marketing automation and CRM platform for contacts, lists, campaigns, automations, deals, forms, messaging, and customer lifecycle workflows.
agentUseSummary: Enter the current user's account-specific ActiveCampaign API URL and unique API token. Relay validates the exact official origin and token-bound user, then exposes only the binding summary, twenty-five List lifecycle summaries, and twenty-five Campaign lifecycle summaries; contacts, user identity, content, audiences, reports, arbitrary queries, pagination, broader APIs, and writes remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: ACTIVECAMPAIGN_API_URL
credentialRequirements.label: ActiveCampaign API URL
credentialRequirements.helpText: Copy the exact HTTPS API URL from Settings > Developer; Relay accepts only an official account-specific api-us1.com origin.

credentialRequirements.name: ACTIVECAMPAIGN_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: ActiveCampaign API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Copy the current user's unique API key from Settings > Developer. Rotating it invalidates this connection.

capabilities.label: Account binding
capabilities.description: Validate the exact account origin and token-bound user.

allowed.label: Read account binding
allowed.description: Validate the exact API origin and token-bound user ID without returning user identity fields.

allowed.label: List recent lists
allowed.description: Read one fixed page of twenty-five List lifecycle summaries.

allowed.label: List recent campaigns
allowed.description: Read one fixed page of twenty-five Campaign lifecycle summaries.

blocked.label: Access contacts or identity
blocked.description: Contacts, email addresses, phone numbers, user identity fields, custom fields, tags, scores, consent, and contact activity are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access campaign content or reports
blocked.description: Campaign names, messages, content, audiences, recipients, links, opens, clicks, replies, bounces, and reports are outside V1.

blocked.label: Change or send ActiveCampaign data
blocked.description: Creating, editing, importing, sending, scheduling, automating, or deleting ActiveCampaign resources is outside V1.

blocked.label: Access broader ActiveCampaign APIs
blocked.description: Deals, automations, events, ecommerce, forms, messages, webhooks, administration, and custom objects are outside V1.

blocked.label: Run arbitrary requests
blocked.description: Arbitrary origins, paths, filters, orders, pages, limits, automatic pagination, crawling, synchronization, exports, and raw API access are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Three bounded metadata-only reads run automatically; identity, contacts, content, reports, broader APIs, raw requests, exports, and writes stay blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same three read-only tools run while exact-origin and token-user binding, fixed requests, page limits, audit, redaction, and provider limits remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts three bounded ActiveCampaign metadata wrappers and attaches the encrypted user API token and validated official account origin server-side.
Railway mounts three bounded ActiveCampaign metadata wrappers and attaches the encrypted user API token and validated official account origin server-side.

providerSetup.nextAction: The customer copies their account-specific API URL and current user's unique API key from ActiveCampaign Settings > Developer. Use a dedicated least-privilege user where the account plan supports one, then verify the user binding and representative List and Campaign lifecycle reads.

evidence.supports: ActiveCampaign documents account-specific HTTPS API URLs, a user-specific API key in the Api-Token header, and /api/3/users/me as the authentication example.
GET /api/3/lists returns List metadata and accepts a bounded result limit; Relay fixes page one and strips sender, analytics, address, link, and relationship fields.

GET /api/3/campaigns supports send-date ordering and returns Campaign lifecycle fields; Relay fixes page one and strips names, messages, audiences, delivery metrics, reports, links, and relationships.
ActiveCampaign documents limit and offset pagination with typical maximum pages of 100; Relay fixes limit 25 and offset 0 and never follows pagination.
